t: Why he stopped a hand reaching for the middle
a: كُلُوا بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مِنْ حَوَالَيْهَا وَاعْفُوا رَأْسَهَا فَإِنَّ الْبَرَكَةَ تَأْتِيهَا مِنْ فَوْقِهَا
p: Kulū bismi-Llāhi min ḥawālayhā wa-ʿfū raʾsahā, fa-inna-l-barakata taʾtīhā min fawqihā
m: Eat in the name of Allah from around it and leave its top alone, for the blessing comes down onto it from above.
